# [TASK] Admin Dashboard page (Eureka/Gateway/Kibana/metrics links, ADMIN-only)

## Task
A `/admin` page in the frontend (`frontend/lmdb`), visible only to logged-in users whose role is `ADMIN`, with cards linking to the ops tools already running: Eureka discovery, the gateway's health/routes, Kibana, and metrics.

These tools run on separate ports a developer has to remember (8761, 5601, the gateway actuator). There was no single place to check whether everything is up after logging into the app.

## Scope
Not in scope: a local Prometheus/Grafana in docker-compose — that stack exists only for the minikube/Kubernetes deployment (`docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md` §12). This page links to whatever is configured; it does not add new infrastructure. Admin *write* actions (user management, etc.) are out of scope — this is a read-only ops view.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] NavBar shows an "Admin" link only when `user.role === 'ADMIN'` (`NavBar.test.jsx: "shows an Admin link only for users with the ADMIN role"` and `"does not show an Admin link for a non-admin user"`)
- [x] `/admin` redirects non-admins and logged-out users to `/` (`AdminDashboard.test.jsx`: the no-stored-session, profile-error, and non-admin redirect tests)
- [x] Dashboard shows 4 cards — Discovery, Gateway, Kibana, Metrics — each with a live up/down check against the tool's health endpoint (`AdminDashboard.test.jsx: "renders the dashboard and all four infrastructure cards..."`; `StatusCard.test.jsx`; `useServiceStatus.test.jsx`)
- [x] All URLs configurable via `.env`/`.env.local`, none hardcoded (`grep -c 'import.meta.env.VITE_' frontend/lmdb/src/components/Admin/AdminDashboard.jsx` → 3; documented in `frontend/lmdb/.env.example`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** not estimated (closed before hour estimates were required)

## Notes
`Role.ADMIN` exists on `User` and is returned by login/`/users/profile`, but nothing assigned it when this closed — provisioning an admin account needed a manual DB update until #238. No backend route was gated by role at the time; the gateway's `/admin/**` gating landed later in #237.
